name: The Sweeney
description: Jack Regan, an unethical officer of the Flying Squad, uses unorthodox methods to pursue criminals with the help of his partner, George Carter.

videos.title: Ringer
videos.overview: After Regan’s car is stolen with invaluable surveillance photos from a stakeout, the thief gives a heads-up to Sweeney’s target.

videos.title: Jackpot
videos.overview: Regan’s flying squad falls under suspicion after they apprehend a gang of hijackers, but a bag with 35,000 pounds in it has somehow disappeared.

videos.title: Thin Ice
videos.overview: Regan clashes with an arrogant police superintendent when a crime kingpin is allowed to leave the country and go to France.

videos.title: Queen’s Pawn
videos.overview: After a high-powered lawyer gets three petty thugs off on a murder charge, Regan is authorized to use whatever means necessary to bring the hoodlums in.

videos.title: Jigsaw
videos.overview: Regan is convinced that Eddie Boyse, a recently released career criminal, is responsible for a robbery, but Boyse was with Regan when the crime occurred.

videos.title: Night Out
videos.overview: When the Superintendent finds out that there is a bank robbery in progress on a Saturday afternoon, he assigns Regan to visit an old girlfriend whose apartment is adjacent.

videos.title: The Placer
videos.overview: Regan adopts a new identity as an ex-con and goes undercover as a truck driver to expose a hijacking ring.

videos.title: Cover Story
videos.overview: It’s unclear whether a beautiful crime reporter is involved with a criminal gang or just a catspaw.

videos.title: Golden Boy
videos.overview: When seedy informant Harry Fuller is spotted by Regan in a pub flush with money, he knows something is up and interrogates Harry.

videos.title: Stoppo Driver
videos.overview: After their own getaway driver is killed fleeing police, a gang blackmails a young policeman into being their driver by kidnapping his bride.

videos.title: Big Spender
videos.overview: The Smith Brothers, a vicious group of mobsters, abandon their usual strong-arm tactics to run a parking ticket scam at a car park.

videos.title: Contact Breaker
videos.overview: After Danny Keever, a convict on weekend release and due for parole, is framed in a bank robbery, Regan works to clear him.

videos.title: Abduction
videos.overview: After Regan gets a tip about an upcoming robbery from a trusted informant, the gang kidnaps his daughter to blackmail him into inaction.

videos.title: Chalk and Cheese
videos.overview: Giles Nunn and Carrie Selhurst are an upper crust couple who, partly for kicks and for the profits, commit highway robbery in lonely country lanes, along with the lower class boy Tommy Garret, whose dad is a friend of George Carter. Regan is on to them and Carrie gets arrested, but her unwillingness to cooperate leads to the death of the next victim.

videos.title: Faces
videos.overview: When a gang hijack an armoured security truck, Regan, Carter and the Flying Squad set up an ambush to catch the crooks. But who's the informer ?

videos.title: Supersnout
videos.overview: An informant of Regan’s tells him about a hijack involving a lorryload of cigarettes where he will be the look-out man. But can Regan trust his snout?

videos.title: Big Brother
videos.overview: Regan loses his patience with a thug he is questioning about a wages snatch, and soon the press are sniffing round for a police brutality story.

videos.title: Hit and Run
videos.overview: A case of mistaken identity provides tragic circumstances when a hit goes wrong; Regan and Carter manage to break the hit-and-run ring, and then try to stop another accident.

videos.title: Trap
videos.overview: Regan and Carter are confronted by a newsman with information on an unsolved robbery. And why are the pair being photographed ?

videos.title: Golden Fleece
videos.overview: Chief Inspector Haskins is framed for corruption while Regan and Carter investigate a spate of break-ins. Is there a connection ?

videos.title: Poppy
videos.overview: Violent criminal Vic Labbett returns to England to recover the proceeds of an earlier robbery, and Regan and Carter must stop him before he can get his hands on the loot.

videos.title: Stay Lucky, Eh?
videos.overview: Regan and Carter are on the case when a pair of robbers are themselves robbed at gunpoint.

videos.title: Trojan Bus
videos.overview: Regan and Carter investigate an art deal that is more than it seems, and ends up in a wasteground shoot out.

videos.title: I Want the Man
videos.overview: Regan's snout is abducted after passing on information about a switch of some stolen diamonds. Regan and Carter must catch the villains while protecting their source.

videos.title: Country Boy
videos.overview: Regan and Carter are called in when alarm bells start ringing all over their patch. Who is setting them off - and why?

videos.title: Thou Shalt Not Kill!
videos.overview: Regan and Carter are called to a siege at a bank, where two armed robbers are holding hostages.

videos.title: Selected Target
videos.overview: While in prison, inmates Titus Oates and Colly Kibber plan a robbery.

videos.title: In from the Cold
videos.overview: Regan and Carter go after Billy Medhurst, implicated in a robbery that resulted in a policeman being shot and crippled. But is the past clouding Regan's judgement?

videos.title: Visiting Fireman
videos.overview: Regan gets involved in a secret government deal, thanks to Shebbeq, a Turkish cop.

videos.title: Tomorrow Man
videos.overview: Regan is assigned to ensure the safe shipment of a gold bullion consignment.

videos.title: Taste of Fear
videos.overview: How will new recruit Bob Hargreaves cope with an investigation into a violent burglary?

videos.title: Bad Apple
videos.overview: Regan and Carter go undercover to assess corruption charges made against CID officers.

videos.title: May
videos.overview: Regan tries to help out the son of a friend when the lad is implicated in an assault.

videos.title: Sweet Smell of Succession
videos.overview: Regan gets involved in gangland warfare following the death of one of London’s leading villains.

videos.title: Down to You, Brother
videos.overview: Regan is fitted up by an ex-con to get his daughter's dodgy boyfriend out of the picture.

videos.title: Pay Off
videos.overview: Carter's girlfriend asks him to find a missing villain, but Regan is suspicious.

videos.title: Loving Arms
videos.overview: Regan must find the source of illegal guns that are flooding the market.

videos.title: Lady Luck
videos.overview: Regan knows the identity of a robber, but has a difficult time proving his guilt.

videos.title: On the Run
videos.overview: An armed robber is sprung from jail and comes looking for Regan.

videos.title: Messenger of the Gods
videos.overview: Regan and Carter have a suspect in mind for the theft of a consignment of mercury, but he has an alibi.

videos.title: Hard Men
videos.overview: Regan and Carter are reluctantly teamed up with a Scottish officer.

videos.title: Drag Act
videos.overview: The Sweeney get incorrect information from informants, allowing a gang of villains to make off with some contraband alcohol.

videos.title: Trust Red
videos.overview: After a criminal dies during a robbery, Regan and Carter can find no leads.

videos.title: Nightmare
videos.overview: Regan's girlfriend has a nightmare that has similarities to a deadly incident.

videos.title: Money, Money, Money
videos.overview: Regan and Carter try to catch a man trying to blackmail a pools winner about the part he played in a robbery.

videos.title: Bait
videos.overview: Regan is determined to nail a modern-day Bonnie and Clyde.

videos.title: The Bigger They Are
videos.overview: Regan discovers that successful people will stop at nothing to keep skeletons buried.

videos.title: Feet of Clay
videos.overview: Regan is asked to help a criminal from his past, whose son has been kidnapped.

videos.title: One of Your Own
videos.overview: Carter winds up behind bars in an attempt to solve a jewellery robbery.

videos.title: Hearts and Minds
videos.overview: Regan and Carter get caught up in a plot to prevent a foreign head of state from getting his hands on an experimental drug to treat his heart condition.

videos.title: Latin Lady
videos.overview: A rich gynaecologist is attacked by a gang of villains who rob him of his suitcase.

videos.title: Victims
videos.overview: Carter discovers that an informant was involved in the shooting of a colleague.

videos.title: Jack or Knave
videos.overview: Regan finds himself in deep trouble when an allegation of corruption is made by the Police Complaints Department. A security van is robbed, and a guard identifies one of the robbers.
